{"metadata":{"description":"A nano re-implementation of Cordis and DeepSeek Harness, an AI agent runtime built out of plugins, small enough to read in an afternoon.","id":"gh:1337896726","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"nano-cordis","slug":"SheltonLiu-N/nano-cordis","topics":["cordis","cordis-plugin","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","nano","nano-cordis"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A nano re-implementation of Cordis and DeepSeek Harness, an AI agent runtime built out of plugins, s"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"mall enough to read in an afternoon."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"NanoCordis is a small, readable codebase that answers one question: **how do you build an AI agent r"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"untime out of plugins?** It contains two layers, about 1600 lines of TypeScript in total:"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- `src/cordis/` — a minimal re-implementation of the Cordis plugin framework that keeps every core i"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"dea (plugins, services, dependency-driven loading, effects, events, configuration-driven composition"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", hot reload) and leaves out the rest.
- `src/harness/` — a minimal agent harness built on it, in th"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"e shape of DeepSeek Harness: a session log that is the only source of truth, a loop that asks a mode"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"l and runs its tool calls, a tool pipeline, an approval policy, a command line — each one a plugin."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"You can read the whole thing in an afternoon. Wherever the real projects do more at a specific place"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" in the code, a short `// Omitted:` or `// Differs:` comment says what they do and why; whole subsys"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"tems that are simply absent are listed at the end of this document. Either way you always know where"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" the full version goes further."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"An **agent harness** is the program around a language model: it keeps the conversation, decides what"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" the model sees, executes the tools the model asks for, and talks to the user. Every such program en"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ds up with the same tension: it needs many replaceable parts (models, tools, storage, interfaces, po"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"licies), and those parts need to find each other without hard-wiring."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Cordis** is a plugin framework built for exactly that. Its core idea is that a program is a set of"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" plugins mounted into a shared *context*: a plugin registers *services* other plugins can use, decla"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"res which services it needs, and everything it registers is undone automatically when it is unloaded"},{"id":"p8s4","text":". Load order falls out of dependencies, and reloading a plugin is just unload plus load. **DeepSeek "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"Harness** (dsh) applies this idea to an agent runtime without exception: the model adapter, the tool"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" registry, the session log, even the agent loop are plugins."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Both real projects are large. NanoCordis keeps their design and drops their size, so you can see the"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" mechanism with nothing in the way."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Try it without cloning — the package is on npm:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"To read and change the code, clone this repository:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The default configuration uses a scripted fake model (no API key needed). It asks to run one bash co"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"mmand, so answer `y`:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 2. A context is a container of services; `inject` says what a plugin needs"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`ctx.provide('prompt', value)` puts a service in the shared table. A plugin lists the services it ne"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"eds in `inject`; it starts only when they all exist, stops when one disappears, and starts again whe"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"n it comes back (`refresh.ts`). Nobody orders the plugins by hand — mount them in any order and they"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" sort themselves out. Reading `ctx.prompt` inside a plugin that did not declare `prompt` throws (a p"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"lugin may always read the services it provides itself, and those an enclosing plugin declared or pro"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"vides); reading a declared service that has gone throws too, rather than handing back `undefined`. `"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ctx.get('prompt')` is the escape hatch for optional services: it returns the service when its provid"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"er is running and `undefined` otherwise."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 5. One capability, three parts"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The shell capability is split the way dsh splits every replaceable capability: `shell.ts` is the **s"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ervice definition** (request, spec, result, and an explicit `resolve()` that fills defaults), `shell"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"-local.ts` is a **provider** (bash on this machine), `tool-bash.ts` is a **consumer** that exposes i"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"t to the model. The consumer depends on the definition only; swap the provider line in `cordis.yml` "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"and nothing else changes. The model service is split the same way (`llm.ts` / `llm-openai.ts` / `llm"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" else changes. The model service is split the same way (`llm.ts` / `llm-openai.ts` / `llm-fake.ts`)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What is left out on purpose"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Cordis features not implemented** (whole features are listed here; where an omission touches a spe"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"cific line, a `// Omitted:` comment sits there too): isolated service realms and per-service config "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"interception; listener filtering by context (the basis of dsh's per-agent scopes); `bail` and `once`"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"; generator effects and awaited async setup; callable services, `Service.check` and async init; `ctx"},{"id":"p24s5","text":".set / accessor / mixin`; the per-service config carried by the object form of `inject` (its keys st"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ill name the required services); automatic retry of failed plugins; in-place config updates with `in"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ternal/update`; internal events; the logger; loader groups, transactional rollback, write-back and `"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"!!js` expressions; HMR through Node's module graph."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Where NanoCordis deliberately behaves differently:** effects are accepted only while a plugin is a"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ctive; cleanups run one by one instead of concurrently; `emit` isolates a throwing listener; a faile"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"d plugin stays failed; waterfall's `next` is composed per listener; class plugins are detected by th"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"e `class` keyword; entries without an `id` are rejected; a config change remounts the entry; a modul"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"e that fails to reload is reported per entry, without rolling anything back."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**dsh mechanisms not implemented:** streaming and per-chunk logging; the inbox with follow-up, steer"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ing and injected context; `agent/pre-step`, `agent/turn-stopping`, `agent/request-error`; cancellati"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"on; the agent registry and handles; scopes and per-session presets; subagents, workflows, background"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" jobs; context compaction; sandboxing; multi-provider routing and retry; approval audit events and p"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"olicies; the `tools/execute` wrapper, guards, `tools/result`; parallel tool calls; crash repair; for"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ks; projections, search, telemetry; bundles, profiles and patch layers; the web UI, SDK and ACP. The"},{"id":"p26s7","text":" log uses the OpenAI message format directly instead of dsh's provider-neutral one."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Where to look in the real code:**"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| NanoCordis | Real project |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `src/cordis/context.ts` | cordis `packages/core/src/context.ts`, `reflect.ts` |
